facts.fact: The Central Bank of Tunisia issued Circular n° 2026-10 on payment establishments on 25 September 2026, binding rules on their services, accounts, agents and governance; it takes effect three months after publication.
facts.system: Circulaire BCT n° 2026-10 relative aux établissements de paiement

facts.fact: Article 51 repeals and replaces Circular n° 2018-16 of 31 December 2018 on the activity and functioning of payment establishments, which was therefore in force until then.
facts.system: Circulaire BCT n° 2018-16 relative aux établissements de paiement

facts.fact: Article 39 refers to Circular n° 2020-11 of 18 May 2020 on the conditions for providing domestic mobile payment services as a text that applies alongside it.
facts.system: Circulaire BCT n° 2020-11 relative aux services de paiement mobile domestique

facts.fact: Circular 2026-10 authorises payment establishments to open three tiers of client payment accounts, transfer funds and issue electronic payment instruments, and requires the BCT to keep a register and publish a list of licensed establishments (Articles 1, 16, 42).
facts.system: Circulaire BCT n° 2026-10 relative aux établissements de paiement

facts.fact: Article 3 of Circular 2026-10 requires payment establishments to join the payment and clearing systems suited to their activities; the circular takes effect three months after 25 September 2026.
facts.system: Circulaire BCT n° 2026-10 relative aux établissements de paiement
